name: a11y-motion-reduced-motion-check
description: Finds every animation, auto-playing carousel, video, parallax and flashing element, checks SC 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide, SC 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold and SC 1.4.2 Audio Control, and verifies the site honors the `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` media feature (technique C39, supporting AAA SC 2.3.3) with emulation in DevTools and Playwright.
